lines.gurmukhi: ਬੁਢਾ ਹੋਆ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦੁ ਕੰਬਣਿ ਲਗੀ ਦੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: budhaa hoaa sekh phareed ka(n)ban lagee deh ||
lines.translation: Shaykh Fareed has grown old, and his body has begun to tremble.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵਰੑਿਆ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਭੀ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਖੇਹ ॥੪੧॥
lines.transliteration: je sau varhiaa jeevanaa bhee tan hosee kheh ||41||
lines.translation: Even if he could live for hundreds of years, his body will eventually turn to dust. ||41||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਬਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਐ ਬੈਸਣਾ ਸਾਂਈ ਮੁਝੈ ਨ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa baar paraaiai baisanaa saa(n)ee mujhai na dehi ||
lines.translation: Fareed begs, O Lord, do not make me sit at another's door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਏਵੈ ਰਖਸੀ ਜੀਉ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਲੇਹਿ ॥੪੨॥
lines.transliteration: je too evai rakhasee jeeu sareerahu lehi ||42||
lines.translation: If this is the way you are going to keep me, then go ahead and take the life out of my body. ||42||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਧਿ ਕੁਹਾੜਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਘੜਾ ਵਣਿ ਕੈ ਸਰੁ ਲੋਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)dh kuhaaRaa sir ghaRaa van kai sar lohaar ||
lines.translation: With the axe on his shoulder, and a bucket on his head, the blacksmith is ready to cut down the tree.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਹਉ ਲੋੜੀ ਸਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਤੂ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਅੰਗਿਆਰ ॥੪੩॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa hau loRee sahu aapanaa too loRahi a(n)giaar ||43||
lines.translation: Fareed, I long for my Lord; you long only for the charcoal. ||43||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਇਕਨਾ ਆਟਾ ਅਗਲਾ ਇਕਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਲੋਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa ikanaa aataa agalaa ikanaa naahee lon ||
lines.translation: Fareed, some have lots of flour, while others do not even have salt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਗਏ ਸਿੰਞਾਪਸਨਿ ਚੋਟਾਂ ਖਾਸੀ ਕਉਣੁ ॥੪੪॥
lines.transliteration: agai gae si(n)njaapasan chotaa(n) khaasee kaun ||44||
lines.translation: When they go beyond this world, it shall be seen, who will be punished. ||44||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਸਿ ਦਮਾਮੇ ਛਤੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਭੇਰੀ ਸਡੋ ਰਡ ॥
lines.transliteration: paas damaame chhat sir bheree sado rad ||
lines.translation: Drums were beaten in their honor, there were canopies above their heads, and bugles announced their coming.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਸੁਤੇ ਜੀਰਾਣ ਮਹਿ ਥੀਏ ਅਤੀਮਾ ਗਡ ॥੪੫॥
lines.transliteration: jaai sute jeeraan mahi theee ateemaa gad ||45||
lines.translation: They have gone to sleep in the cemetary, buried like poor orphans. ||45||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ ਉਸਾਰੇਦੇ ਭੀ ਗਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa kothe ma(n)dap maaReeaa usaarede bhee gae ||
lines.translation: Fareed, those who built houses, mansions and lofty buildings, are also gone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਗੋਰੀ ਆਇ ਪਏ ॥੪੬॥
lines.transliteration: kooRaa saudaa kar gae goree aai pae ||46||
lines.translation: They made false deals, and were dropped into their graves. ||46||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਖਿੰਥੜਿ ਮੇਖਾ ਅਗਲੀਆ ਜਿੰਦੁ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਮੇਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa khi(n)thaR mekhaa agaleeaa ji(n)d na kaaee mekh ||
lines.translation: Fareed, there are many seams on the patched coat, but there are no seams on the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਰੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਚਲੇ ਮਸਾਇਕ ਸੇਖ ॥੪੭॥
lines.transliteration: vaaree aapo aapanee chale masaaik sekh ||47||
lines.translation: The shaykhs and their disciples have all departed, each in his own turn. ||47||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦੁਹੁ ਦੀਵੀ ਬਲੰਦਿਆ ਮਲਕੁ ਬਹਿਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa duhu deevee bala(n)diaa malak bahithaa aai ||
lines.translation: Fareed, the two lamps are lit, but death has come anyway.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੜੁ ਲੀਤਾ ਘਟੁ ਲੁਟਿਆ ਦੀਵੜੇ ਗਇਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੪੮॥
lines.transliteration: gaR leetaa ghat lutiaa deevaRe gaiaa bujhaai ||48||
lines.translation: It has captured the fortress of the body, and plundered the home of the heart; it extinguishes the lamps and departs. ||48||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਵੇਖੁ ਕਪਾਹੈ ਜਿ ਥੀਆ ਜਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਥੀਆ ਤਿਲਾਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa vekh kapaahai j theeaa j sir theeaa tilaah ||
lines.translation: Fareed, look at what has happened to the cotton and the sesame seed,

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਮਾਦੈ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਗਦੈ ਕੁੰਨੇ ਕੋਇਲਿਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: kamaadai ar kaagadai ku(n)ne koiliaah ||
lines.translation: the sugar cane and paper, the clay pots and the charcoal.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਦੇ ਅਮਲ ਕਰੇਦਿਆ ਏਹ ਸਜਾਇ ਤਿਨਾਹ ॥੪੯॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)de amal karediaa eh sajaai tinaah ||49||
lines.translation: This is the punishment for those who do evil deeds. ||49||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕੰਨਿ ਮੁਸਲਾ ਸੂਫੁ ਗਲਿ ਦਿਲਿ ਕਾਤੀ ਗੁੜੁ ਵਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa ka(n)n musalaa sooph gal dil kaatee guR vaat ||
lines.translation: Fareed, you wear your prayer shawl on your shoulders and the robes of a Sufi; your words are sweet, but there is a dagger in your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਦਿਸੈ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਦਿਲਿ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੫੦॥
lines.transliteration: baahar disai chaananaa dil a(n)dhiaaree raat ||50||
lines.translation: Outwardly, you look bright, but your heart is dark as night. ||50||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰਤੀ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਜੇ ਤਨੁ ਚੀਰੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa ratee rat na nikalai je tan cheerai koi ||
lines.translation: Fareed, not even a drop of blood would issue forth, if someone cut my body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਨ ਰਤੇ ਰਬ ਸਿਉ ਤਿਨ ਤਨਿ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo tan rate rab siu tin tan rat na hoi ||51||
lines.translation: Those bodies which are imbued with the Lord - those bodies contain no blood. ||51||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੋ ਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਰਤੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੰਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu tan sabho rat hai rat bin ta(n)n na hoi ||
lines.translation: This body is all blood; without blood, this body could not exist.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਹ ਰਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sah rate aapane tit tan lobh rat na hoi ||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with their Lord, do not have the blood of greed in their bodies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਲੋਭੁ ਰਤੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai paiai tan kheen hoi lobh rat vichahu jaai ||
lines.translation: When the Fear of God fills the body, it becomes thin; the blood of greed departs from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu baisa(n)tar dhaat sudh hoi tiu har kaa bhau duramat mail gavaai ||
lines.translation: Just as metal is purified by fire, the Fear of God removes the filthy residues of evil-mindedness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੫੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak te jan sohane j rate har ra(n)g laai ||52||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those humble beings are beautiful, who are imbued with the Lord's Love. ||52||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਸੋਈ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਢੂਢਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਥਹੁ ਲਭੀ ਵਥੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa soee saravar dhoodh lahu jithahu labhee vath ||
lines.translation: Fareed, seek that sacred pool, in which the genuine article is found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਪੜਿ ਢੂਢੈ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਚਿਕੜਿ ਡੁਬੈ ਹਥੁ ॥੫੩॥
lines.transliteration: chhapaR dhoodhai kiaa hovai chikaR dubai hath ||53||
lines.translation: Why do you bother to search in the pond? Your hand will only sink into the mud. ||53||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਨੰਢੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਰਾਵਿਓ ਵਡੀ ਥੀ ਮੁਈਆਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa na(n)dhee ka(n)t na raavio vadee thee mueeaas ||
lines.translation: Fareed, when she is young, she does not enjoy her Husband. When she grows up, she dies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਕੂਕੇਂਦੀ ਗੋਰ ਮੇਂ ਤੈ ਸਹ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੀਆਸੁ ॥੫੪॥
lines.transliteration: dhan kooke(n)dee gor me(n) tai sah naa mileeaas ||54||
lines.translation: Lying in the grave, the soul-bride cries, "I did not meet You, my Lord." ||54||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਸਿਰੁ ਪਲਿਆ ਦਾੜੀ ਪਲੀ ਮੁਛਾਂ ਭੀ ਪਲੀਆਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa sir paliaa daaRee palee muchhaa(n) bhee paleeaa(n) ||
lines.translation: Fareed, your hair has turned grey, your beard has turned grey, and your moustache has turned grey.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਗਹਿਲੇ ਬਾਵਲੇ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਰਲੀਆਂ ॥੫੫॥
lines.transliteration: re man gahile baavale maanahi kiaa raleeaa(n) ||55||
lines.translation: O my thoughtless and insane mind, why are you indulging in pleasures? ||55||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕੋਠੇ ਧੁਕਣੁ ਕੇਤੜਾ ਪਿਰ ਨੀਦੜੀ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa kothe dhukan ketaRaa pir needaRee nivaar ||
lines.translation: Fareed, how long can you run on the rooftop? You are asleep to your Husband Lord - give it up!

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦਿਹ ਲਧੇ ਗਾਣਵੇ ਗਏ ਵਿਲਾੜਿ ਵਿਲਾੜਿ ॥੫੬॥
lines.transliteration: jo dih ladhe gaanave gae vilaaR vilaaR ||56||
lines.translation: The days which were allotted to you are numbered, and they are passing, passing away. ||56||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ ਏਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਏ ਚਿਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa kothe ma(n)dap maaReeaa et na laae chit ||
lines.translation: Fareed, houses, mansions and balconies - do not attach your consciousness to these.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੀ ਪਈ ਅਤੋਲਵੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਸੀ ਮਿਤੁ ॥੫੭॥
lines.transliteration: mitee paee atolavee koi na hosee mit ||57||
lines.translation: When these collapse into heaps of dust, none of them will be your friend. ||57||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਇ ਮਰਗ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa ma(n)dap maal na laai marag sataanee chit dhar ||
lines.translation: Fareed, do not focus on mansions and wealth; center your consciousness on death, your powerful enemy.
